aspect: EXAMPLE - the count, and that it is a floor
description: IOM documented 686 deaths and disappearances on the US-Mexico border in 2022 - the deadliest land route worldwide on record, and nearly half of all 1,457 migrant deaths in the Americas that year. IOM states these are the lowest available estimates.
energy_note: Six hundred and eighty-six, counting low.

aspect: EXAMPLE - the desert does most of it
description: Nearly half - 307 - of the 2022 border deaths were linked to crossing the Sonoran and Chihuahuan Deserts. For comparison, at least 212 people died in the Sahara that year.
energy_note: More died in the Sonoran than the Sahara.

aspect: The gaps in the count are named
description: IOM records that missing official data includes Texas border county coroners' offices and the Mexican search and rescue agency - so the undercount is specific and known, not vague.
energy_note: They can name which morgues do not report.

aspect: The price, and who holds it
description: Smuggling fees run into thousands of dollars, frequently borrowed against family land or paid to people connected to the groups who also run the kidnapping. The debt survives whether or not he arrives.

aspect: Prevention through deterrence is the design, not the failure
description: Routing crossings away from urban corridors into desert was policy, on the reasoning that hostile terrain would deter. The deaths in BOR-001-002 are the predicted output of a chosen strategy rather than an accident of geography.

aspect: The remains that are never identified
description: A substantial share of recovered remains are never identified, so a family in Oaxaca has no death and no return - the same condition as DES-001, produced by a different mechanism.
